segments.name: Gold Jewelry (Group-wide — Laopu Gold discloses only ONE IFRS 8 reportable operating segment; there is no per-segment breakdown in any filing. Revenue is separately disaggregated by sales channel (boutiques vs. online), product type (gold jewelry vs. other), and geography (Chinese mainland vs. overseas), but these are supplementary revenue notes, not IFRS 8 segments, and no segment-level profit is disclosed for any of them.)

fiscal_years.note: Company-wide margin (non-IFRS adjusted net profit RMB1,501.7m / revenue); gross margin ~41.2%. No segment split exists.
fiscal_years.source: Laopu Gold Annual Results Announcement for the year ended December 31, 2024 (filed 2025-03-31), Notes 3 & 4 and MD&A

fiscal_years.note: Company-wide margin (non-IFRS adjusted net profit RMB5,029.3m / revenue). Boutique count grew 36→45; overseas revenue +361.0% YoY to RMB3,941.9m (14.4% of total) as first overseas boutiques (Singapore) opened.
fiscal_years.source: Laopu Gold Annual Results Announcement for the year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-23), Notes 3 & 4 and MD&A

quarters.quarter_label: H2 FY2024 (Laopu reports semi-annually, not quarterly — no Q3/Q4 standalone filing exists)
quarters.note: Derived by subtracting actual filed 1H2024 figures from actual filed FY2024 figures (both audited/reviewed disclosures); not separately reported by the company.
quarters.source: Derived from FY2024 Annual Results Announcement (2025-03-31) minus 1H2024 Interim Results Announcement (2025-08-20)

quarters.note: Gross margin declined to ~38.1% (from 41.2% in FY2024) due to rapid gold price rises Jan-Apr 2025; company states short-term GM fluctuation did not affect income scale.
quarters.source: Laopu Gold Interim Results Announcement for the six months ended June 30, 2025 (filed 2025-08-20)

quarters.note: Derived by subtracting actual filed 1H2025 figures from actual filed FY2025 figures; not separately reported by the company.
quarters.source: Derived from FY2025 Annual Results Announcement (2026-03-23) minus 1H2025 Interim Results Announcement (2025-08-20)

quarters.note: Revenue growth decelerated sharply to +60.3% YoY (vs +251% in 1H2025) as falling gold/bullion prices cooled demand; stock fell ~24% on results day. Online channel share rose to 22.2% of revenue (+171.9% YoY) vs. offline 77.8%. Figures sourced from secondary reporting of the company's own announcement (primary HKEXnews PDF not directly extractable); rounded to nearest RMB1m.
quarters.source: Company interim results announcement dated 2026-08-25, as reported by Sina Finance (finance.sina.com.cn, 2026-08-25) and corroborated by Bloomberg (2026-08-25)
